title: Token Research Guide: How to Use Should I Buy This?
excerpt: A step-by-step walkthrough of SyNexus's fastest research tool — paste, scan, read, share.
author: SyNexus Editorial
trustLine: Non-custodial · You sign every trade · Not financial advice.

blocks.text: Open the home feed, paste a Solana symbol or mint into Should I buy this?, and tap scan. You get Avoid, Watch, or OK in plain English plus supporting signals.
New visitors get three deep scans before signup. Re-scanning the same token does not consume another slot — compare reads over time as conditions change.
Tap the small ? button on the scan panel for a watch-and-listen tutorial that explains what the tool does and what it never will do.
Send the scan URL to friends so everyone references the same mint and Sentinel fusion — critical during fast memecoin cycles.
